title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct Immaculata spaces for solo work, group projects, tutoring, archival research and outdoor study, with access limits noted.

cards.title: Build the Group Project Here
cards.subtitle: Whiteboards, desks and lounge seating in Gabriele Library
cards.notes: Bring the project outline and use the whiteboards, desk spaces and lounge seating for an organized group work session.
cards.short_summary: A collaboration-focused floor with several ways to spread out and work together.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata states that its renovated Gabriele Library first floor offers collaborative workspaces with whiteboards, desk spaces and lounge seating for group discussion.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Gabriele Library; use is subject to the library's posted operating hours and any campus access requirements.

cards.title: Settle In for Solo Reading
cards.subtitle: Individual study space inside Gabriele Library
cards.notes: Choose this library setting when the task calls for independent reading, note-taking or focused research rather than conversation.
cards.short_summary: The library explicitly supports individual work as well as collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Gabriele Library as providing space for individual study, collaboration and academic support.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library page for the current daily schedule; hours and temporary space closures can change during breaks and renovations.

cards.title: Research the University’s Own Archive
cards.subtitle: Second-floor archival research room in Gabriele Library
cards.notes: Contact the archivist before a source-heavy project, then use the room’s university records and changing artifact displays.
cards.short_summary: A specialized destination for primary-source research on Immaculata’s history.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata identifies the Heritage Room on Gabriele Library's second floor as the location of its Archives, which supports research and scholarship through access to university records.
cards.access_notes: Visits may be arranged by appointment or made during business hours; the office is usually open weekdays from 9:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.

cards.title: Bring the Draft, Not Just the Deadline
cards.subtitle: Collaborative writing help on Gabriele Library’s first floor
cards.notes: Schedule a conversation for brainstorming, drafting or revision, and arrive with the assignment prompt plus your current work.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor workspace for developing an assignment with a trained reader.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata's Writing Center is located on the first floor of Gabriele Library and works collaboratively with students at any stage of the writing process.
cards.access_notes: Writing assistance is for Immaculata students; use the center's scheduling link to arrange an appointment.

cards.title: Turn Coaching into a Work Session
cards.subtitle: Assignment workspace in the Learning Support Services suite
cards.notes: Use the lounge to act on academic-coaching guidance, work through an assignment and print materials needed for the next step.
cards.short_summary: A support-oriented lounge designed for classwork, coaching and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata Magazine describes the Learning Support Services lounge as a general space for academic coaching, class assignments and printing.
cards.source_title: Learning Support Services at Immaculata University
cards.access_notes: Located within Learning Support Services; confirm current availability with the office before relying on an open work area.

cards.entity_name: Learning Support Services Peer Tutoring Areas
cards.title: Give the Study Group a Defined Base
cards.subtitle: Three group-study areas sized for four to five students
cards.notes: Gather a small group of up to five, bring one shared problem set and check tutoring availability before choosing a work area.
cards.short_summary: Three compact spaces pair small-group work with nearby learning support.
cards.evidence_claim: The university's magazine documents three separate peer-tutoring and group-study areas, each accommodating four to five students.
cards.source_title: Learning Support Services at Immaculata University
cards.access_notes: These areas are part of Learning Support Services; contact the office for current tutoring schedules and space-use procedures.

cards.title: Keep Residence-Hall Work Separate
cards.subtitle: A dedicated study room for Gillet Hall residents
cards.notes: Use the dedicated room for coursework when you want to leave your bedroom behind without leaving the residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-specific study room within Gillet Hall’s residential community.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata's residential communities page states that Gillet Hall has a community lounge and a dedicated study room.
cards.access_notes: Gillet Hall is a residence hall with ID swipe-card entry; treat this as a resident-access space rather than a general campus room.

cards.title: Open the Laptop Near the Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Residential lounge with a computer lab and smart television
cards.notes: Residents can pair laptop work with the nearby computer lab; choose another space when lounge recreation would be distracting.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall lounge with technology nearby for practical coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata lists the Terrace Marian Lounge as having a computer lab and smart television and identifies it as an amenity for Marian and DeChantal residents.
cards.access_notes: Located in a residence hall with ID swipe-card entry; access is limited by residential security and housing rules.

cards.entity_name: Applied Technology Lab Group Study Room
cards.title: Collaborate Beside the Technical Tools
cards.subtitle: Dedicated group-study room in the Applied Technology Lab
cards.notes: Use the dedicated room for collaborative technical work or faculty-guided research after confirming that the lab is available.
cards.short_summary: A defined collaboration room attached to Immaculata’s technology-focused lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata states that a dedicated room in the Applied Technology Lab provides space for student group study and collaborative faculty research.
cards.access_notes: The university does not publish open-use hours or reservation rules on the cited page; confirm access with the lab or academic program.

cards.title: Take the Reading Outside
cards.subtitle: The green between Lourdes, Nazareth and Villa Maria halls
cards.notes: Bring a charged device or printed reading and use the lawn for daylight work when weather and scheduled campus events allow.
cards.short_summary: A named campus green that the university explicitly identifies for outdoor study.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata describes Back Campus as a green space suitable for outdoor study and identifies it as the quad between Lourdes, Nazareth and Villa Maria halls.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space with no hours or reservation rules stated on the cited page; planned events and weather may affect availability.
